I have a clear picture of the architecture. Here's my answer.

---

Yes, this is very doable. I dug into how "livestreams" is wired up today so we can scope it properly.

## How it works now

The livestream series is driven by a folder + frontmatter convention, mirrored on the episodes series:

- **Content**: [`content/livestreams/`](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/tree/main/content/livestreams) — currently just [`ls01.md`](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/blob/main/content/livestreams/ls01.md) (with `streamId: "LIVE 01"`) and an `index.md`.
- **Layout**: [`quartz.layout.ts`](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/blob/main/quartz.layout.ts) defines `livestreamsSection` (sidebar) and `livestreamsCarousel` (landing page), both titled `"Livestreams"` and filtered on the `livestreams/` slug prefix.
- **Rendering**: [`EpisodeCarousel.tsx`](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/blob/main/quartz/components/EpisodeCarousel.tsx#L57-L85), [`RecentNotes.tsx`](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/blob/main/quartz/components/RecentNotes.tsx#L45), and [`Content.tsx`](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/blob/main/quartz/components/pages/Content.tsx#L115-L138) all read `streamId` (falling back from `episodeId`) and render it as a small badge — that's the "LIVE 01" label.
- **Styling**: [`custom.scss`](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/blob/main/quartz/styles/custom.scss#L55-L105) and `Content.tsx` target `body[data-slug^="livestreams/"]`.

So three distinct things map to your request:
1. **Display label** "Livestreams" → "Special Events" (titles in `quartz.layout.ts`).
2. **The "LIVE 01" badge** → drop it (stop rendering `streamId`), and optionally show a **sub-category** badge instead (Meetup, etc.).
3. **The URL/slug** `/livestreams/...` — separate decision (see below).

## Proposed approach

- **Sub-categories**: add a `category` frontmatter field (e.g. `category: "Meetup"`) to each event page, and reuse the existing badge slot — render `category` where `streamId` is rendered today. That keeps the visual design identical, just swaps "LIVE 01" for "Meetup". No new component needed.
- **Drop numbering**: remove the `streamId` field from content and stop reading it for this series. Episodes keep `episodeId` untouched.
- **Rename**: change the carousel/section titles and `itemNoun` to "Special Events" / "special event".

## Step-by-step plan

1. Decide the **slug question** (clarification below) — folder rename vs. display-only.
2. In `quartz.layout.ts`: rename `livestreamsSection`/`livestreamsCarousel` titles to `"Special Events"`, set `itemNoun: "special event"`.
3. Add `category` rendering: update `EpisodeCarousel.tsx`, `RecentNotes.tsx`, and `Content.tsx` to use `frontmatter.category` for the badge on this series (and remove `streamId` from the fallback for it).
4. Update content: drop `streamId` from `ls01.md`, add `category`, rename `index.md` title ("All Livestreams" → "All Special Events"), update its body text.
5. Update slug-targeted CSS in `custom.scss` and `Content.tsx` if we rename the folder.
6. Build locally (`npx quartz build`) and verify the carousel, sidebar list, and event page render.

## One thing I need from you

**Do you want to change the URL too** (`/livestreams/...` → `/special-events/...`)?
- **Display-only** (keep the `livestreams/` folder/slug): fastest, zero broken links, but the URL still reads "livestreams".
- **Full rename** (folder → `special-events/`): cleaner, but changes the public URL of [`ls01.md`](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/blob/main/content/livestreams/ls01.md) — I'd want to confirm there are no external links to it first.

Also: confirm **"Special Events"** as the final label, and give me the initial **sub-category list** (Meetup, …) so I can set up the values. Once you pick, I'll implement it.

---
